format: mono MP3 48 kHz 128 kbps, mastered by scripts/normalize_audio.sh (combat/* targets)
purpose: Combat presentation sounds that are not a weapon's own report: rounds passing the camera, ricochets, surface impacts, rounds striking a man, and the man's pain. Generated with ElevenLabs Sound Effects by scripts/generate_combat_sfx.py (.github/workflows/combat-sfx-generate.yml on a branch); played by battle/modules/15-combat-audio.js through Assets/audio/manifest.json categories flyby, ricochet, impacts, flesh and pain. Presentation only: no clip changes the battle.

rules.oneSoundPerInstance: A round plays at most one flyby clip, and its end point at most one impact or ricochet; a body it strikes one flesh hit; a man hit at most one pain clip. The runtime caps concurrent voices per group so a burst is a run of distinct sounds, never a wall of noise.
rules.singleShot: A clip marked singleShot holds exactly one event (one onset): one crack, one hit, one ricochet.
rules.variations: Each variation is its own generation, never one generation pitch-shifted.

crack.trigger: supersonic round passes within 6 m of the camera
crack.prompt: Photorealistic field-recorded sound effect, no music, no voices unless stated, no electronic or gamey tones, no gunshot report. A single supersonic rifle bullet cracking past the listener's head at close range: one sharp, dry, whip-like snap with a very short airy tail, recorded from the listener's position. One bullet only, then silence.

whiz.trigger: a .45 within 10 m of the camera, or a supersonic round between 6 and 10 m
whiz.prompt: Photorealistic field-recorded sound effect, no music, no voices unless stated, no electronic or gamey tones, no gunshot report. A single bullet whizzing past the listener's head: one short buzzing zip that rises and falls in pitch as it passes, recorded from the listener's position. One bullet only, then silence.

whine.trigger: some rounds ending on stone, brick or metal within 60 m of the camera, instead of the impact clip
whine.prompt: Photorealistic field-recorded sound effect, no music, no voices unless stated, no electronic or gamey tones, no gunshot report. A single rifle bullet striking stone and ricocheting away: a sharp hard ping followed by a thin whining whistle that fades into the distance. One ricochet only, outdoors.

dirt.trigger: round ends in the ground within 40 m of the camera
dirt.prompt: Photorealistic field-recorded sound effect, no music, no voices unless stated, no electronic or gamey tones, no gunshot report. A single rifle bullet slamming into soft earth nearby: a dull thud with a short spray of dirt and pebbles pattering down. One impact only, outdoors.

masonry.trigger: round ends on a building or stone wall within 40 m
masonry.prompt: Photorealistic field-recorded sound effect, no music, no voices unless stated, no electronic or gamey tones, no gunshot report. A single rifle bullet hitting a brick and stone wall nearby: a hard sharp crack with chips of masonry and dust falling. One impact only, outdoors.

wood.trigger: round ends in timber, a door or a tree trunk within 40 m
wood.prompt: Photorealistic field-recorded sound effect, no music, no voices unless stated, no electronic or gamey tones, no gunshot report. A single rifle bullet punching into a thick wooden beam nearby: a solid knock with a short splintering crunch. One impact only.

metal.trigger: round ends on metal within 40 m
metal.prompt: Photorealistic field-recorded sound effect, no music, no voices unless stated, no electronic or gamey tones, no gunshot report. A single rifle bullet striking a sheet of steel nearby: a bright hard metallic clang with a short ringing tail. One impact only.

vegetation.trigger: round ends in a hedge, bush or foliage within 40 m
vegetation.prompt: Photorealistic field-recorded sound effect, no music, no voices unless stated, no electronic or gamey tones, no gunshot report. A single rifle bullet tearing through a dense hedgerow nearby: a quick snap of twigs and a rustle of torn leaves. One impact only, outdoors.

hit.trigger: a round strikes a soldier within 40 m of the camera, once per body it strikes
hit.prompt: Photorealistic field-recorded sound effect, no music, no voices unless stated, no electronic or gamey tones, no gunshot report. A single bullet striking a man's body at close range: a heavy wet thump through cloth and webbing, short and visceral, not gory. One hit only, no voice.

wounded.trigger: a soldier hit and still fighting, within 60 m of the camera; one per man, never again within 3 s
wounded.prompt: Photorealistic field-recorded sound effect, no music, no voices unless stated, no electronic or gamey tones, no gunshot report. Voice allowed: one adult male WW2 infantry soldier, outdoors, suddenly shot and wounded: a single sharp involuntary cry of pain, a gasp then a strained grunt. No words, one man, one short cry.

down.trigger: a soldier hit and dropped (not an instant head-shot kill), within 60 m of the camera
down.prompt: Photorealistic field-recorded sound effect, no music, no voices unless stated, no electronic or gamey tones, no gunshot report. Voice allowed: one adult male WW2 infantry soldier, outdoors, shot and falling: a single choked cry that breaks into a groan as he goes down. No words, one man, one cry.
